text:
Morgan: Quick sync — we need a consistent client-facing message for when we gracefully fail over to a lower-tier model (soft fallback). Customers keep seeing confusing deprecation copy + 503 and it's leaking into SRE pages.
Samir: Can you paste an example of what they're seeing? I want to check the payload we're sending to clients.
Morgan: Example from support ticket:
Samir: thanks. Looks like SDK surfaces `model_deprecated` text and a generic 503 at the same time.
Samir: Proposal: split signals. 1) HTTP status (503/200) for transport, 2) `code` field for contract (`fallback_soft`, `fallback_hard`, `quota_blocked`, `rate_limited`), 3) `hint` for console copy.
Elaine: For console badging we should show a small yellow badge: "degraded route — fallback active" and link to route history. UX: avoid the word "deprecated" unless model is actually end-of-life.
Kai: Telemetry: emit metric `client.fallback.type` with tags {route, fallback_type, tenant_id, rollout_phase}. Also add `client.exposure` boolean to track whether we exposed fallback to the client vs kept silent.
Jorge: Important: quota-induced fallbacks are different from model degradation. Quota fallback must include `quota_window_remaining` and `quota_tier` in telemetry and hint messages.
Samir: Agreed. Suggested canonical error payload (SDK/HTTP):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "status":"ok",
  "meta":{
    "route":"text-generation-a",
    "fallback":"soft"
  },
  "response":{...}
}
```
OR for visible fallback
```
HTTP/1.1 429
{
  "error":{
    "code":"quota_blocked",
    "message":"Request routed to fallback model due to quota. See console for options.",
    "hint":"upgrade or retry in 30s",
    "exposure":true
  }
}
```
Elaine: That's helpful. Console copy draft: "Routed to fallback model — quality may be reduced. Learn how to get dedicated capacity or adjust quotas." Keep copy short and link to KB.
Morgan: Localization: we need to avoid terse technical words. Use phrases product people approve. Also we must ensure SDKs don't automatically surface internal error IDs to end users.
Kai: For rollout UX: when a canary triggers fallback we should emit `console.notice` with sample responses and a toggle to view raw payloads for debugging. Also a histogram of latencies for fallback vs primary.
Jorge: Ops question — when fallback is automatic and transparent (no client exposure), should we still bump SLO alerts? I vote yes but with a separate severity.
Samir: Make it configurable per route: `expose_fallback_to_client: true|false`. Default false. If true, include `exposure:true` and friendly `hint` field.
ops-bot: @eng-platform canary deploy finished for route text-generation-a (version v2026-03-21-canary). :rocket:
Morgan: Next actions: Samir to write RFC for error payload and mapping, Elaine to draft console copy and badge mocks, Kai to add telemetry tags, Jorge to document quota differences. Check-in Thursday.
Samir: I'll stub the RFC in docs repo and ping here when ready. +1
Elaine: Will post mocks by EOD. :eyes:
Kai: Will update the telemetry PR with `client.fallback.type` and `client.exposure` tags.
Jorge: I'll add quota-specific telemetry fields and a short runbook for ops.
Morgan: Thanks all. If anyone hits a support thread with "deprecated" language, please point to the draft copy until console is live. :thumbsup:
